summary: The top banner with the app name, a tagline, a brain icon and a Semantic Search Enabled label.
purpose: Shows the app name and tagline so the owner knows which app they are using.
why: Likely reason: a shared banner keeps the same branding at the top of the page.

debug: If the banner is missing, check that the page imports this component. If the label says enabled but searches fail, check the server, because this file does not test it.
